paragraphs: The X6 xDrive30d has been a mainstay of the X6 diesel range since the F16 generation launched in 2014, continuing through the current G06 body. The earlier F16 generation (2014–2019) uses the N57/B57 engine — a 3.0-litre inline-six diesel that was itself a development of BMW's long-running N57 diesel family. From 2019, the current G06-generation X6 xDrive30d switched to the B57 — a newer, more efficient inline-six diesel that's part of BMW's B-series engine family. Both are 3.0-litre six-cylinder diesels, but they sit in different generations of BMW's diesel engine lineage, with different component layouts and wear characteristics.
about.boldParagraph: The X6 xDrive30d is no longer in production, but we continue to rebuild and replace engines for every one still on the road.
